title: Lady Gaga in Harlequin Live: One Night Only
original_title: Lady Gaga in Harlequin Live: One Night Only
overview: Lady Gaga in Harlequin Live: One Night Only is a concert film by American singer Lady Gaga, documenting the live debut of her 2024 album Harlequin. The film was recorded on September 30, 2024, during an intimate, fan-exclusive performance at The Belasco in Los Angeles. Gaga and Michael Polansky acted as co-executive producers.
